name: refactor
summary: A change to structure that must not change behaviour. Consumers first, gate second, move third.

steps.title: Name every consumer before you move or delete anything
steps.done_when: You have the list for the whole workspace, and you have grepped for crate-root re-exports and feature-gated imports, which the graph cannot see.

steps.title: Pin the behaviour with a gate that passes today
steps.run: hexa loop gate '<command that exits 0 now and must still exit 0 after>'
steps.done_when: The command is recorded and it exits 0 before you change anything. This is the one gate shape that is allowed to start green.

steps.title: Make the change under the gate
steps.run: hexa do run "<the change>" --file <path> --evidence '<command that must exit 0>'
steps.done_when: The evidence command exits 0 and the change is committed.

steps.title: Prove the behaviour did not move with the code
steps.run: hexa verify "<the claim that behaviour is unchanged>"
steps.done_when: The verdict is CONFIRMED against evidence the tool gathered itself.

steps.title: Grade the shape you leave behind
steps.done_when: The grade is at or above where it was before you started. A refactor that lowers the grade is not a refactor.
